claims: For every nu>0, every smooth solution (u,p,f) of the viscosity-1 incompressible Navier-Stokes equations on an open spatial domain Omega times an interval I transforms to a viscosity-nu solution on sqrt(nu) Omega times I by u_nu(x,t)=sqrt(nu)u(x/sqrt(nu),t), p_nu(x,t)=nu p(x/sqrt(nu),t), f_nu(x,t)=sqrt(nu)f(x/sqrt(nu),t). When the spatial L2 norm is finite, its square scales by nu^(5/2). This conditional local transformation neither constructs blowup nor closes any Clay branch.
